falsifier: Reject immediately for causal-test failure, nondeterminism, invalid execution, missing terminal evidence, or insolvency. Reject the no-control base for net Sharpe below 0.75, nonpositive annualized return, Calmar below 0.40, drawdown above 30%, doubled-cost Sharpe below 0.35, fewer than four positive folds, positive-quarter fraction below 0.55, trial-adjusted probability positive below 0.90, positive-PnL concentration above 0.40, any nonpositive bull/bear/chop return, fewer than three positive-Sharpe regimes, worst-regime Sharpe below -0.25, failed long-bull/short-bear/combined-chop roles, or either sleeve failing an activity floor. A base or neighborhood failure makes Team 03 DNF; controls and a second pivot cannot rescue it.
selection_rule: Pass every hard, development, fold, regime, sleeve, doubled-cost, concentration and activity gate with the no-control base; then require at least three of four fixed neighbors profitable, neighbor median Sharpe at least 0.50 and concentration no greater than 0.40. Any failure ends Team 03 as DNF.
thesis: A high-volume BTC-beta-residual impulse is tradable only after the next fully closed 8-hour residual reverses sign, evidencing absorption rather than assuming immediate mean reversion.
